item.title: Unjou no Fairy Tale
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: COSMIC CUTE
  • 発売日: 2018-03-23
  • スコア: 7.470000000000001/10 (65 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 雲上のフェアリーテイル
  • 英語名: Unjou no Fairy Tale

あらすじ

This is a fairy tale that takes place in the lawless town of Kaguya that floats in the sky. Tsukasa runs Café Amelia with a lone employee, the self-proclaimed future great magician Natsu. However, they have another side to them; they are part of a team of justice-fighters that do everything from preventing thefts to serving as personal guards. The other members of the team are also frequent visitors to the coffee shop: the songstress Daria and the strongest swordswoman Makoto.

item.description:

  • ブランド: COSMIC CUTE
  • 発売日: 2016-10-28
  • スコア: 7.44/10 (123 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 空のつくりかた -under the same sky，over the rainbow-
  • 英語名: Sora no Tsukurikata -Under the Same Sky, Over the Rainbow-

别名

  • 天空的作法

あらすじ

Naoka is a city shrouded in a pervasive thick fog. It is known not only for its vampires, but also as the place for people who have lost sight of their goals in life. Ryou is one such individual who lost his purpose and confidence after a past failure. While he works for a detective company, but he’s rather a jack-of-all-trades dealing with minor troubles, like searching for lost belongings or fixing roofs.

item.title: Gleam Garden no Shoujo -witch in gleamgarden-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: COSMIC CUTE
  • 発売日: 2013-07-26
  • スコア: 7.45/10 (129 人評価)
  • 日本語名: グリムガーデンの少女 -witch in gleamgarden-
  • 英語名: Gleam Garden no Shoujo -witch in gleamgarden-

あらすじ

There are girls in the world known as ‘witches’ who have the ability to bring disaster to their surroundings by merely wishing for something strong enough. This ability known as ‘gleam’ is said to be caused by a mental abnormality. Their numbers had increased rapidly over the past few years and society has gradually become more chaotic as a result. The ‘gleam garden’ is a place where witches are interned and where they are taught how to control their abilities so that they do not harm others. Touji is a ‘protection controller’, supporting four girls who had been cast off by society for being witches. He wants to lead them to a new life, and also to find out about the truth of his own past.

あらすじ

Kotarou is a normal student at Hatao Gakuen who is a member of the ‘counselling room’. The ‘counselling room’ was viewed by many as a place for complaints and random requests. Even though he was pitied by them for being part of some a troublesome place, he didn’t mind it since he naturally liked helping out with other people’s problems.
